title: Published v0.1.1 bootstrap acceptance

context.summary: Verify installation bootstrap from public v0.1.1 release URLs.
context.background: After publishing, the signed manifest and release assets must be consumable from a clean temporary MINDORY_HOME.

in: Point published-release acceptance at v0.1.1 assets.
Run live public download verification with signed manifest, checksum validation and staging.
Verify packaged installer dry-run from the downloaded bundle.
Document failure output and recovery hints.

acceptance_criteria: MINDORY_PUBLISHED_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE_LIVE=true pnpm published-release:acceptance downloads public v0.1.1 assets.
Signature and checksum verification pass for untampered assets.
Downloaded bundle stages into a temporary MINDORY_HOME and packaged installer dry-run succeeds.
Failed download or verification messages identify the broken asset.

manual_checks: Confirm acceptance URLs point to v0.1.1.
Confirm v0.1.0 is still available as historical release.

definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
